posts.zh:
dsh-prompt 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。输入框旁的 prompt 工具箱面板：24 条内置深度模板 + 自定义模板，/prompt 触发源 + 智能推荐悬浮卡，点选即插入当前对话。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-565a532358225f5a7c86.html
posts.en:
dsh-prompt is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Right-side prompt toolbox panel with 24 built-in deep templates plus user-defined ones, accessible via the /prompt slash trigger and a context-aware floating suggestion card; one-click inserts the selected prompt into the composer.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-565a532358225f5a7c86.html
